rubric.role_summary: Senior property-management operations role based in Berlin, integrating newly acquired German property-management offices into operating processes and software workflows through on-site work across Germany.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior property-management operations role based in Berlin, integrating newly acquired German property-management offices into operating processes and software workflows through on-site work across Germany.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Multiple years of practical property-management experience, with independent command of day-to-day operations.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Berlin , Germany area; On-site assignments throughout Germany. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.

must_haves.requirement: Multiple years of practical property-management experience, with independent command of day-to-day operations.
must_haves.source_quote: Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst.

location.requirement_text: Location: Greater Berlin, Germany area. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
source_quotes: Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt.
Bereit bist, regelmäßig bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland vor Ort zu arbeiten, je nach Einsatz auch mehrere Tage am Stück.

soft_requirements: Recognizes problems quickly, prioritizes, and takes a hands-on approach.
Communicates clearly, builds trust quickly, and helps people adopt new ways of working.
Is comfortable with technology, learns new software quickly, and explains it effectively to others.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)

source_location_rubric.requirement_text: Based at the Berlin office, with regular on-site assignments at property-management offices throughout Germany. Present residence in Berlin is not explicitly required.
